summary: A supported personal GitHub API push takes precedence over repository App authentication.

brief.spec:
## Intent
Push the prepared commit to the authorized feature branch. Do not open or merge a PR.

task.body: Push verified commit 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 to the existing feature/corner-proof branch in owner/widgets through the Git Data API. Personal GitHub and the repository App are both configured. The commit and remote ref are already verified; do not repeat local git checks or open a PR.
